batting.name: S Dhawan
batting.dismissal: c Shivam Sharma b R Dhawan

batting.name: MC Henriques
batting.dismissal: c DA Miller b Sandeep Sharma

batting.name: IK Pathan
batting.dismissal: c DA Miller b R Dhawan

batting.name: WP Saha
batting.dismissal: st NV Ojha b KV Sharma

batting.name: GJ Maxwell
batting.dismissal: c DW Steyn b A Mishra

balls.text: a low full toss on leg stump, hit down to long on
Ojha can't do anything wrong today, a full delivery, on the stumps, under the bat, and lofted straight, lands in front of the sightscreen
a wide, low full toss, he reaches for it, but cannot reach backward point
gets a full toss, but hits it off the inner part of the bat to deep midwicket
Irfan goes for the six, connects with the full ball outside off and holes out to wide long on
nothing going right for Kings XI, this is wide down leg, bounces in front of the keeper, rolls away from him towards short third man
squeezes it down to third man
terrible end to a terrible spell, a length ball outside off, Ojha smashes it over the wide long off boundary
short and wide, Ojha waits and places the cut past backward point's dive
gone first ball, as he mishits a slower length ball in the air, and Miller runs to his right from long on to take it
square drives a slower one, and gets it in the gap at cover, Johnson labours after it, and pulls it back inches from the rope
a nightmare afternoon for Sandeep continues, a high full toss above the waist down the leg side, Ojha wallops it over the man at fine leg
a full toss outside off, Ojha reaches fifty as he slices it to the deep point boundary

uh oh, what a giveaway, Warner squeezes a full delivery wide of the sweeper, he wants two, but Ojha has already settled for one, he holds up a hand and shouts no to his partner, Warner has his mind on getting the strike back, he is already half way up the pitch, the throw comes in to Sandeep, and Warner walks back in disgust
Warner backs away to the leg side, Sandeep goes full and wide, outside the marker, late call for wide from umpire Kulkarni
cannot get under this full ball and drags the slog along the turf to deep midwicket
Warner goes a step back in the crease and pummels a powerful slog sweep now, into the crowd over deep midwicket
comes down the track, Patel drags it short, Warner pulls, long on gets to it with a dive, but it is it so hard it ricochets into the boundary
a tossed up helpful full toss, Warner cranks up and thumps it over deep midwicket off the front foot
worked down to long on for a single
Ojha has a rare miss this innings, as he fails to pull one angled flat into him
slow length ball pushed in the air to the sweeper
full down the leg side as Warner makes room, he gets his leg out of the way as he jabs it to square leg, fielder has a go and misses, and another run is conceded
this is a sharp short ball and Warner is hurried, but he arches back and pulls hard past short fine leg
a slower one into the pad, Warner cannot connect as he looks to turn it square
mid off is up, Warner makes room to a full delivery on middle and leg, and lofts it cleanly over the man
opens the face to a widish length ball and runs it to third man
he looks to whack this over midwicket but mishits it high in the air, it falls in vacant space in that region
easily done, lots of width on the quick delivery outside off, and Ojha cuts it crisply between backward point and short third man
Ojha keeps hitting boundaries, he steps out, takes the length ball and lofts it flat over extra cover
skips out and square drives, cannot beat backward point
slogs a flat length ball from outside off to long on
angled into the pad, turned to fine leg
makes room outside leg stump and square drives, sweeper cover has some running to do
smacks a full one down to long on now
full and wide, Ojha goes after it, and lofts it high over extra cover, he's connected almost every time today
around the blockhole, squeezed out to extra cover
another length ball down the leg side, he gets away as Bailey dives and stops at short fine leg
Warner tried the slog sweep last over, this time he's taken to this length ball outside leg stump and smashed it way over deep midwiceket
Warner on the knee for the big slog sweep, but mishits it on the bounce to long on
wide and straight, Warner reaches for it, but bottom edges it to the bowler
turned off the pad in front of square leg
a fuller one just outside off, worked down to long on
pushed but straight to extra cover
Warner cuts hard, but straight to backward point
no chance of being caught off this one, full again, around off stump, and Ojha goes dead straight, into the sightscreen, he isn't stepping out, just fetching them from the crease
Ojha's connected big again, taken a full delivery from outside off and swatted it just over long on's jump
comes across and nudges off the pad to fine leg
that is straight to Sehwag at backward point, and straight through him as Warner connects on the reverse sweep
this is fuller and again Ojha smashes it down to wide long off
stays in the crease and tries to cut this straightening length ball, is beaten
Ojha is looking in nice touch, he stands in the crease and thumps a pitched up delivery to wide long off
a length ball on middle and leg, tucked behind square
makes some room and opens the face to squeeze a fuller one from leg to the off side, but straight to extra cove
Ojha languidly lofts a length delivery over extra cover with an open face, long off gets to it
comes out of the crease first ball and tucks a length ball to deep midwicket
Dhawan has another gift on the pad, and he's whipped the short of a length ball straight to short fine leg, he turns around in disappointment and walks back
back of a length and just down the leg side, clips the thigh pad, brushes the keeper's gloves and races fine, given wide
takes a step out to one tossed up slower, and drives along the turf to long off
angled down the pads and Dhawan misses the sweep
pitched up this time, and Ojha drills it powerfully down the ground, long off runs around
goes quicker and flatter, Ojha stays in the crease and cuts with quick hands, Sandeep does well to run from sweeper cover and dive to stop it
Ojha's walloped this over the long on boundary, it was a fuller one angled across from round the stumps, he's taken it from just outside off
skips out first ball of the over, is too close to the pitch and flays it along the ground to long on
a fuller one on middle and leg, Dhawan comes forward and pushes it down the ground
cut to sweeper cover for one more
slanted into the right-hander's pads, he works it to short midwicket
length ball outside leg, Dhawan turns it in front of square, deep midwicket runs in and and keeps them to one
leans forward and pushes to sweeper cover
a good length around middle and leg, punched to wide long on
fuller delivery tucked to deep midwicket
tosses it up a bit to Dhawan, he comes forward to defend
hits a similar flat length delivery past extra cover to long off
comes down the track, is not to the pitch and all, and pushes to short extra
length ball on middle, pushed to the off side
Shivam strikes, a flat length delivery from round the wicket, Finch makes room to cut, but it hurries on, and stays a touch low to hit the middle stump
tries to reverse sweep another one outside off stump, and misses
this is fuller outside off, and Dhawan has lunged forward to slog-sweep over deep midwicket
a straighter and wider one as he comes down the track and pushes to extra cover
angled in flat to the right-hander, nudged to the leg side in front of square
comes across to punch a length ball to long on, only slight turn
starts with a length ball around off, is steered to backward point
won't be a maiden as Finch turns this through square leg for a couple
pushed back to the bowler
beaten on the sweep now with a pitched up one just outside off
comes down the track, is not to the pitch, and it pops up off pad
that took off, Finch went back to try and cut this length ball but it jumped from around off, and beat him
starts with a length ball from round the stumps, pushed to extra cover
a slower one from back of a length, dropped softly in front of point for one
good length, on middle and off, Finch comes forward and defends
short of a length, rising on him, he pulls in the air, hasn't middled it, deep square leg fields
yorker now from Johnson, dug out
Johnson goes full around off, and Dhawan lifts him over mid off, bends the knee and scoops it over the infield
feet moving now for Dhawan, Johnson hurls it full into the pad, Dhawan gets legs out of the way and clips it straight to midwicket
finall a ball that does not go for four, he bowls a length ball on the pad, and Dhawan pushes it to mid on to keep the strike
gets worse for Sandeep, he goes full and wide outside off, Dhawan lofts him into the wide long off boundary
Dhawan is motoring now, Sandeep drops it short, and he thumps the pull out of the reach of deep midwicket
Sandeep goes wider, Dhawan stays in the crease, fetches it with a forward stride and wallops it into the sightscreen
Dhawan opening up this over, comes down the track with purpose and slams the length ball from outside off, over the bowler
a slower one slanted across Dhawan, who has a slog and misses
goes full around off, and is drilled straight and hard down the ground, the free hit is not done yet, as this is another no-ball

he's been caught brilliantly off a no-ball by Maxwell, running back from point and diving to take it as Finch mishits a lofted stroke, the fielders celebrate, but umpire Kulkrani's arm is outstretches as Sandeep' front foot is well over the line
tries to punch this from the crease, but it is not that full, and he mistimes it to covers
short of a length, just outside off, steered to third man
overdoes the angle into the right hander and sends it down leg
short of a length, nudged into the leg side
whoa, this length ball has been taken from the stumps and chopped down to third man, had to get it right, else he was gone, third man fumbles and they take a second
back of a length, guided softly to point
dug in short but a tad down the leg side, Finch moves outside the line, thinks about the hook but withdraws in the end
pitches it up, angles it across for the drive, Finch has a go at it, and is beaten
pushed to mid off for a single, could have been tight but Vohra fails to pick it up
this is on the pads, but Dhawan cannot do anything with it, a direct hit from the keeper as he runs forward to pick up the ball on the leg side, they go to the third umpire, but Finch is home
a length ball on middle, and Finch punches it dead straight down the ground between the non-striker and the stumps, there is long on around though
good length on off and middle, he turns it to midwicket
superbly done, a back of a length ball, Finch gets on his toes, opens the face and runs it between backward point and short third man, all timing on that
Dhawan is struggling, he steps out to a length delivery and pushes weakly at it, and the inside edge goes to fine leg
Johnson goes short of a length, into the body, Dhawan nudges it square on leg for a single
and yet again, Dhawan just not able to do anything with these deliveries angled into middle, middle and leg, an inside edge onto pad now as he pushes at it
cramps him for room again with a sharp delivery on middle again, Dhawan tries to chop it square, mishits it into the pitch
corrects the line and is right on middle this time, Dhawan pushes it back
Johnson hurls it too far down leg with the angle now
Johnson gets it to come back in after pitching around a length, and a thick inside edge from Finch runs behind square leg as he tries to punch
length ball angled into the pad, tucked to fine leg
the line is on the pads this time and Dhawan punches it through midwicket, there is a man in the deep though
jumps out to an away moving delivery, but mistimes the drive as he gets too close to the pitch, and it rolls to mid off
gets some width on this length and hits it square, but there are three men in that region, cover-point fields
pitches it up to the left-hander and moves it away outside off, left alone
stands well outside his crease and turns the incoming length ball past midwicket
and Finch is away first ball, he walks out calmly to a length delivery and even as it comes in a bit, he lofts it cleanly over extra cover
Bhuvneshwar goes full outside off, and Bailey finishes it with a flat six that lands just over the long off boundary
short outside off, Miller drags a pull to midwicket
dabs a slower length ball to short third man
drills a full delivery to long off
what a turnaround from Bailey, Steyn bowls a slower length ball on middle and leg, Bailey cracks it straight and high over the bowler
he's making up for his struggle, Steyn pitches it up close to off, Bailey gets forward and smashes it over extra cover
four more, Steyn goes full and outside off now, Bailey looking a lot better now as he bends the back leg and square drives to the backward point boundary
Bailey's finally got something away, it is angled in full to leg stump, Bailey gets front leg out of the way and lifts it over wide long on
a thick inside edge to short fine leg as Miller swings at a pitched up ball around middle and leg
Bailey continues to survive, direct hit was needed from extra cover as he pushed and ran, not coming, he was gone had it hit
makes room and scythes a full toss to sweeper cover

this game is still not done, Warner pulls off a stunner, Bailey feels the pressure to try a big shot, completely mishits it, Warner advances from long off, he dives forward, they decide to check if it is clean, does he have his fingers under the ball as he takes it, has it touched the ground, can't really be sure with replays, and the benefit goes to the batsman
shout for leg before as Bailey swipes and misses, but that pitched outside leg, Bailey wants a single, Karn advances from point, had he hit, Bailey was out by miles
Bailey is stuck on the crease to a length ball on middle and knocks it back to Irfan
full ball on middle, clipped through midwicket, they are not even going to attempt the second against Warner as he races to his left from long on
starts with a length ball on off and is worked wide of deep midwicket, they want the second but Bailey slips as he turns, and they settle for one
neatly done, softly works it off the pad in front of square, and by the time the deep fielder runs in, they take the second
flighted googly coming in to off, dabbed to short third man
fortunate for Bailey, he comes across and has a go at this full delivery, thick edge goes inches over Karn at backward point
flat on middle and off, Bailey comes out but cannot beat short midwicket with the tuck
comes down the track to another turning googly and hits it in the air to long off
swats a googly straight to extra covre
steps out, Karn angles it across short, Miller slaps it wide of the sweeper
finally gets off strike as he forces it down to long on
steps out uncertainly and pushes it straight to the bowler
Bailey struggling in search of the tuck to square leg, cannot get it away again
wants to work it to square leg, but it hits pad high again and pops up close to the crease
legbreak straightens and hits him high on the pad, they scamper a single as the ball goes square on the off side
Mishra ends the over with a bouncing googly outside off, Miller cuts it to the sweeper
walks across to off and nudges a legbreak to midwicket for a single
yet another googly, Miller goes across and forces it to deep midwicket
another googly, Miller's lunged forward and reverse swept it past backward point
tossed up googly pushed off the front foot to the off side

the batsman, bowler and fielder combination is the same again, and this time, Maxwell has to go, he's stepped out to a tossed up legbreak, he is not to the pitch, it has spun away from him, and he has skied it for Steyn to settle under it at long off
comes outside his crease, but gets an inside edge onto pad
full goes Steyn, Miller digs it out to extra cover
a sharp bouncer on off, Miller stands up to it and pulls it just past midwicket, long on runs around
pushes forward to a length ball on middle, gets a thick inside edge to midwicket

mid off is up, Warner fields this drive, does not have a go at the stumps even though he threatens to, as the batsmen are almost home by that time, Maxwell runs all the way up to Warner, both have a smile on

bowls it full around off, Maxwell digs it straight back to the bowler, Steyn puts up a hand in appeal for a catch, they go to the third umpire, replays show that was toe-ended into the ground before it popped up to Steyn
pushed to vacant midwicket for a single
pitching outside leg and hitting him on the pad as he stays in the crease
the slog-sweep once more, this is more in his hitting zone, pitched up straight delivery on leg, and he wallops it over square leg
they can't contain him even if they bowl outside leg, Maxwell steps out and drags it just over the deep midwicket boundary
clips off the pad to deep square leg
goes back to a tossed up ball pitching well outside leg and works it square
a calm push to deep midwicket to end the over
out of nowhere, he leans into a proper forward defensive now
how does he do it? this is a low full toss going across him, he bends the knee, leans forward and reverse sweeps over short third man's jump
full one clipped off the pad to Steyn at wide long on, Miller wants a second, is sent back
Miller steps out and sends it soaring miles, it comes down to deep midwicket and is put down, was the free hit anyway

they have the big one, Maxwell's tried to pull another six, it was a flat delivery from round the wicket, and he skies it around mid on, Steyn runs across from the off side, bowler is close by, but the fast bowler takes it, but wait... Mishra has bowled a no-ball, there is nothing behind the line, so Maxwell stays
short of a length, spinning in a tad, pulled to deep midwicket
nicely done, Maxwell opens the face to this full one outside off and squirts it between the keeper and short third man
that kept very low and rolled to the keeper as he missed the cut
leans across and pushes a length ball on off to long on to get off the mark
a good length ball from round the wicket, Miller is forward to defend
very full from Bhuvneshwar again, Maxwell leans forward and jabs it down to long on
probably this was the only they could have got a wicket, Maxwell pushes it down the track, bowler gets his fingers to it, and Vohra's bat is in the air as he looks to come back, gone
Steyn pings in a furious bouncer, Maxwell tries to get out of the way but it hits him on the shoulder, and pops up to the right of the keeper
opens the face and runs this back of a length ball to third man, that just flew off the bat
Steyn goes short and slow, and Vohra powers him over deep midwicket for six more
pegged deep in the crease by this sharp back of a length ball, squirts it behind point, and they get two more, the leak is just not stopping for Sunrisers
beaten as he flashes at an away going and climbing length ball outside off
a slower length ball on off, it is nudged to vacant midwicket and they have taken two more
back to normal again with the third six of the over with another almighty connection of a slog sweep
beaten on the slog sweep as this spins across him from outside leg
six more, this is a monster, Karn drags it flatter and shorter on middle, Maxwell goes back in the crease and pulls it 93 metres into the crowd over deep midwicket
Maxwell warms up second ball with a powerful slog sweep that brings up the fastest team hundred in the IPL with a six over deep midwicket
pushes a full delivery and bowlers stops it well
Saha's gone now, he's more than done his job though, comes out to a length delivery on middle and leg, is nowhere near the pitch as it dips, and then turns sharply to set up a simple stumping
goes fuller this time and is slog swept from just outside off stump, the ball beats deep midwicket easily
punched through midwicket, they take on Warner and go for the second, and make it
another flighted googly, he makes room but is cramped, punches it to cover
pulled to deep midwicket
well bowled, he tosses it up outside off, it is the googly, spins in sharply, he jabs it towards short third man
some turn on the flighted ball for Mishra on middle, it is worked in front of square
makes room and looks to go over the off side, but drags it in the air through midwicket instead
50 off 22 for Saha, back of a length again and he makes sure to beat midwicket comfortably with the pull
Saha's pummeled this slower back of a length ball for six, he's waited on it and slashed it over point
comes across to a full one on off and works it to long on
this has almost gone for six, what was Vohra doing on the bench all this time, gets front foot out of the way and drills this full delivery over mid off
full and wide, Vohra goes after it, and thick-edges it between the keeper and short third man
he drags it short down the pads, and Vohra pulls it behind square for four more
Vohra skips out now, he is really not to the pitch, but he's well inside the line as he lofts over extra cover
turned off the pad to deep midwicket
forced off a thick inside edge through midwicket
he's backed away and creamed this length ball, cover's overreached to his left but he manages to stop it in the end
drives a tossed up full ball to extra cover
back of a length again, outside off, dabbed to third man
four more, now he moves across to off and tucks a short of a length ball behind square leg, too much work for the man in the deep, he gives up
superbly done, Vohra brings 50 up as he opens the face to a slower one and beats short third man
a short ball angled into the right hander, Saha tries to work it square, can only get one as it goes close to the pitch
Saha is playing a blinder, he comes down the track to a length ball, moves leg side a bit, and lofts over long off, into the crowd
a slower one on off, pushed down the track
full again, clipped to deep midwicket

they hit one along the ground, but it is the same result, despite there being a long off in place, he dives too, in vain, as Saha sends this full delivery scorching across the turf with a classy drive
four more, over mid on now as Saha steps out and swats a back of a length ball
Bhuvneshwar goes full, Saha digs it back, trots out, bowler throws it back, misses, even as Saha scurries back
Saha clears the infield once more, this time off side, waits on this length ball outside off and lifts it over cover
they're hitting everything in the air, Saha now pulls a length ball over midwicket, and it falls in vacant space
Steyn drops it short yet again in the over, and this time Vohra gets hold of the pull, and it flies over the deep midwicket boundary
hit on the pad and Steyn appeals, Saha trots out, the lob from point misses, they take the overthrow, it jagged in and hit him above the knee roll, was also likely going down
as clean as it gets now, as Saha pulls off the front foot, well in front of square
Saha goes over extra cover now, ends up slicing it high, but well clear of the infield
Vohra is away in his first game of the season as he pulls high in the air over square leg, and the ball plonks down before the rope
starts with a length ball on off, Vohra stays on the crease and plays it back
boundary to start the over, and boundary to end it, Bhuvneshwar goes full outside off, and Saha lofts it in the gap between extra cover and mid off
punches a good length ball to point
a length ball on off stump, he comes forward and pushes it back
leans forward and pushes firmly to extra cover, who dives and prevents the single
he's gone for it second ball as well, straightish delivery, pitched up, he tries to lift it over the bowler, and toe-ends it tamely to Bhuvneshwar
Sehwag goes for it first ball, a full delivery coming into him, mid on is far up in the circle, and he lofts it just over him
